name: orca
description: Leave it to Orca — every idea, made real.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test && (npm run ledger -- validate .decisions || [ $? -eq 2 ]) && node scripts/check-claude-md-lines.mjs && node scripts/check-hooks-path.mjs && npm run verify:control && npm run verify:scheduler && npm run verify:chain && npm run build --workspace web && npm run verify:ccloop-pin && npm run verify:panel && npm run --ws check
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath scripts/githooks || true
